context: Two friends chat about life and love
purpose: Teach: 義理/絶好/いたずら/惚れ/忘年会/着せ/クビ/真っ先

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日、義理の母と、しっかり話せたの。
lines.en: Yesterday I actually had a real conversation with my mother-in-law.
lines.style: Quiet opening, almost surprised at herself for bringing this up. Tender undercurrent — something resolved or shifted. Pace unhurried, like she's still sitting with the relief of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 絶好の機会、活かしたね。
lines.en: You really made that moment count.
lines.style: Warm recognition without making a big deal of it. Light, genuine. The kind of nod you give across a counter when you mean something.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 娘が、いたずらしちゃったみたい、保育園で。
lines.en: Apparently my daughter got into some mischief at daycare.
lines.style: Dry, affectionate laugh underneath. Matter-of-fact delivery, almost wry — not worried, just observing the absurdity of kids. Quick pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 子供あるあるよ。私、若い頃、先輩に惚れたことあった。
lines.en: Oh, that's classic kid stuff. Actually, when I was younger, I had a crush on someone at work once.
lines.style: Easy, conversational. A small shared memory rising to the surface. Warmth without performing it. Slight hesitation before 'once' — like she's deciding it's safe to say.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今度の忘年会、夫と参加するか迷ってる。
lines.en: I'm still not sure whether to go to the year-end party with my husband.
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful exhale. Weighing something real. Quiet uncertainty — not despair, but honest doubt. Slight trailing-off, like there's more she hasn't said yet.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 娘に新しいワンピース着せて、一緒に行こうよ。
lines.en: Get your daughter a new dress and bring her along with us.
lines.style: Bright invitation, genuine generosity. Quick, assured tone — offering without hesitation. The easy warmth of someone making space. Opens the door like it's already obvious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夫、もしクビになったら、と考えると不安。
lines.en: What worries me is — what if my husband lost his job?
lines.style: Tender surface cracking. Spoken quietly, like she's finally naming the real fear underneath. Pace slows on 'job.' Small vulnerability underneath the practical words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いざという時、真っ先に頼って。
lines.en: When that moment comes, I'm the first person you call.
lines.style: Steady, grounded reassurance. No hesitation, no performance. Direct eye-contact in the voice. Firm but gentle — a promise, not a platitude.
